verdict.rationale: Jan has a local OpenAI-compatible API server, so a downloadable spec is a fair question for this product. However, its API reference is human-readable endpoint docs with curl examples, and it notes that no OpenAPI spec download is documented. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on jan.ai all returned 404, so there is no evidence of a machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
